scheme_name: Stree Shakti Package for Women Entrepreneurs
overview: The Stree Shakti Package for Women Entrepreneurs is a scheme by the State Bank of India (SBI) aimed at supporting women entrepreneurs by providing financial assistance and other benefits to promote women entrepreneurship in India. The scheme offers financial support in the form of loans and other benefits to help women start and expand their businesses.
objectives: To promote women entrepreneurship in India
To provide financial assistance to women entrepreneurs for starting and expanding businesses
To offer concessional interest rates and relaxed collateral requirements for women borrowers
To support women in achieving financial independence and business growth
eligibility: The scheme is available to women entrepreneurs who are Indian citizens, aged 18 years and above, and engaged in or planning to start a business venture. Applicants must have a viable business project and meet the bank's creditworthiness criteria. The scheme is applicable to individual women entrepreneurs, partnership firms, private limited companies, and cooperative societies where women hold a majority stake.
benefits: The scheme offers concessional interest rates, reduced margin requirements, relaxed collateral norms, and extended repayment periods. It also provides access to SBI's digital banking platforms like YONO for easy application and tracking. Additional benefits include waiver of certain processing fees and access to financial literacy and business development support through SBI's initiatives.
financial_support: The scheme provides term loans and working capital finance to women entrepreneurs. The loan amount varies based on the project viability and creditworthiness of the applicant. Interest rates are concessional compared to standard SBI rates, and margin requirements are relaxed. Loans are disbursed through SBI branches or digital channels like YONO app after due diligence and approval.
application_process: 1. Visit the nearest SBI branch or log in to the YONO SBI app. 2. Inquire about the Stree Shakti Package for Women Entrepreneurs. 3. Submit the loan application form along with required documents. 4. Undergo credit appraisal and project viability assessment by the bank. 5. Upon approval, complete documentation and accept the loan offer. 6. Loan amount is disbursed to the designated bank account.
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID)
Address proof (Aadhaar, Passport, Utility bill, Driving license)
Proof of business address (rent agreement, ownership documents)
Bank statements of the applicant (if existing account)
Partnership deed or incorporation certificate (if applicable)
Income proof (IT returns, salary slips, or business income proof)
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted throughout the year.
caveats: Loan approval is subject to credit appraisal and project viability assessment by SBI
Concessional benefits are subject to periodic review and may be revised by the bank
The scheme is applicable only to women-owned or women-led enterprises
Benefits may vary based on the loan product and borrower profile
Applicants must comply with KYC and AML norms as per RBI guidelines
